title: Immunohistology of mouse spleens
protocol: Harvest mouse spleens, embed them in OCT compound embedding medium and freeze in liquid nitrogen.
Cut 7 μm sections and mount them on Superfrost Plus slides.
Incubate slides in humidified chambers overnight at 4°C and dry them.
Fix slides with acetone at 4°C for 10 min.
Block slides with PBS + 5% fetal calf serum at 25°C for 1 h.
Stain blocked sections overnight at 4°C with anti-CD3-phycoerythrin, anti-B220-FITC, and peanut-agglutinin-biotin diluted in blocking buffer.
Wash slides 3 times with PBS + 0.05% Tween 20.
Stain sections with streptavidin-cyanine 5.5 at 25°C for 1 h.
Wash slides 3 times with PBS + 0.05% Tween 20, dry them and mount them with Gelmount.
Capture images at x10 magnification with a Zeiss Axioplan microscope.
